data.text:
BREAKING NEWS
Gaza Ceasefire Talks Progress as Hamas Agrees to Release 10 Hostages

Hamas agreed to release 10 hostages during difficult negotiations as Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar stated a 60-day deal is achievable. President Trump expressed optimism about reaching agreement within two weeks following meetings with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Washington.

Texas Flooding Death Toll Reaches 121
Deadly flooding that devastated Central Texas over July Fourth weekend killed at least 121 people, with more than 170 still missing. The catastrophic floods particularly impacted Kerr County, where 96 deaths were confirmed, including 27 casualties at Camp Mystic summer camp. Search operations continue for the seventh day.

Russia Launches Record Drone Attack on Ukraine
Russia executed its largest drone offensive since invasion began, deploying 741 drones in massive overnight assault on Ukraine. At least two people died in Kyiv, including a 22-year-old police officer, with 16 others injured. Ukrainian forces intercepted 718 attacking drones. The assault followed President Trump's criticism of Vladimir Putin.

Los Angeles Tunnel Collapse Rescue
All 31 construction workers trapped in collapsed Los Angeles wastewater tunnel were safely rescued Wednesday evening. Workers climbed over 15-foot debris pile to reach safety from the 18-foot diameter tunnel, located 400 feet underground in Wilmington. No major injuries reported.

Trump Threatens Brazil with 50% Tariff
President Trump announced 50% tariff on Brazilian imports, citing treatment of former President Jair Bolsonaro as international disgrace. The tariff, effective August 1, represents Trump's highest rate announced this week, despite United States maintaining trade surplus with Brazil.

European Union Developments
European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen survived no-confidence vote in European Parliament, with lawmakers rejecting censure motion. French authorities raided National Rally party headquarters investigating campaign finance violations.

Economic Updates
Wall Street indexes closed higher Wednesday, with Nvidia briefly reaching 4 trillion valuation. Gold futures opened at 3,322 per ounce. Markets showed stability despite ongoing tariff announcements affecting Philippines, Iraq, Libya, and Sri Lanka.

Additional Global News
India conducted nationwide strike against economic reforms. Kurdistan Workers Party announced end of armed struggle against Turkey. Thousands of Syrian refugees prepare to return from Lebanon under UN-backed programs.

A Greek-owned cargo ship sank in the Red Sea after an attack by Yemeni militants. Rescuers braved the waves, saving crew members with lifeboats as the damaged vessel tilted against a dramatic sunset, highlighting geopolitical tensions.
